format_divergence.reason_en: Fifth of eight. The reasoning has not changed — a receptive module has nothing for a transform or error-spot question to test. Past the halfway mark now; if the Part F mix is mandatory, reworking five is the last cheap moment.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What is he allowed before the test?
options: Water, but not the morning medicine
questions.explanation_en: पानी चल जाएगा, and सुबह की दवा छोड़नी पड़ेगी.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What does the dentist tell him about the treatment?
options: Two or three sittings, about a week apart
He needs an X-ray before quoting
questions.explanation_en: दो-तीन सिटिंग लगेंगी, and हफ़्ते-हफ़्ते भर का for the gap.

questions.question_en: Listen again. What was he told about the medicine?
options: Halve the dose after three days
Stop it once the fever goes
Finish the whole course or start again
questions.explanation_en: वो पूरी करनी है। बीच में छोड़ी तो फिर से शुरू.

questions.question_en: You hear शर्मा जी से बात, थकान से कमज़ोरी and पहले से बेहतर. What is से doing across these?
options: The same job each time — marking a source
Three different jobs: with whom, because of what, and than what
Marking the object of the verb
questions.explanation_en: से covers company in conversation, cause, and comparison — three of the six jobs it does in this module.

questions.question_en: पर्ची लानी होगी and खाने के बाद both put a word into the oblique. What triggers it?
options: Whether the sentence is a question
questions.explanation_en: खाने goes oblique because के बाद follows. लानी is different — that is agreement with a feminine object, not an oblique.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: तीसरी डॉक्टर ___ कौन सी लिखी है?
questions.question_read_as: tiisrii ḍôkṭar ___ kaun sii likhii hai?
questions.explanation_en: लिखना is transitive and perfective, so the noun subject takes a separate ने.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: और सुबह की दवा छोड़नी ___ ।
questions.explanation_en: दवा is feminine singular, so the infinitive is छोड़नी and the modal follows it.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मसूड़े के ___ भी दर्द है।

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: नहीं, ग़लत नंबर लग ___ है।
questions.explanation_en: नंबर is masculine and it is the subject — the number connected, not the caller.

questions.question_en: Listen again. Which form fills the gap?
questions.question: मैं ___ में हूँ, सिग्नल कम है।
questions.question_read_as: maiṁ ___ meṁ huuṁ, signal kam hai.
questions.explanation_en: में is a postposition, so the plural goes oblique.
